Our consistent leadership in early childhood education is a model for the entire nation. Extremely proud of the incredible progress made over the last 20 years to give our children a strong start in life to achieve their American Dream.

Alabama stands ready to support Space Command and its vital mission.

Enjoyed spending time with the Mountain Lakes Chamber of Commerce yesterday to discuss how they are managing the historic levels of growth in the region. I look forward to continuing to advocate for federal policies in Washington that advance their goals.

I’ve spent years fighting the onerous and harmful 1071 rule published by the Biden Administration’s CFPB, including through my PROTECTED Act in the Senate. I look forward to seeing this final rule published so we don’t punish small businesses with unnecessary regulation.

Keeping our kids from being addicted to their phones and social media should be part of the MAHA agenda. 

When my generation grew up, it was strange to spend all day inside staring at screens. Today it’s become odd for children to spend all day outside — riding bikes, climbing trees, exploring, acting like kids.

Social media addiction has led to declines in physical health, increased anxiety and depression, weaker academic outcomes, and worse social cohesion.

It was great to be with members of the Huntsville Madison County Chamber this morning to provide a Washington update. Thank you, to my friend and colleague, @ChrisCoons, for joining us, as well.
